new.n: Roycroft Farm, north of Sidnaw (1911 plat)
new.pl: S edge of secs. 32-33 T48N R35W, Houghton County
new.v: Coins, buttons, farm and rail-camp relics
new.st: The 1911 Houghton County plat book (T48N R35W page) draws Roycroft Farm as a long tract along the south edge of secs. 32 and 33, just north of Sidnaw, with an old railroad bed running north from it through secs. 28-29 to the county line.
new.t: Look for the farmstead clearing, foundation stones and the old rail bed edge. Ask the landowner first.
src: Plat book of Houghton County, Michigan (Weston & Hancock, c1911), T48N R35W page (Neb's screenshot)

new.n: Nestee's old log railroad junction, sec. 20 T47N R35W (1911 plat)
new.st: The 1911 Houghton County plat book (T47N R35W page) draws "Nestee's old log railroad", a logging grade running from sec. 30 northeast through secs. 19, 20 and 17 to the railway at the sec. 9/16 line, crossing the Old Road in sec. 20. There are log roads and a trail in secs. 28-29, and farm dots in secs. 7, 8 and 18. Junctions of logging grades often had a camp or a landing.
new.t: Walk the old grade for a camp clearing, spikes, stove parts and bottles. Ask the landowner first.
src: Plat book of Houghton County, Michigan (Weston & Hancock, c1911), T47N R35W page (Neb's screenshot)
https://quod.lib.umich.edu/m/micounty/5117704.0001.001/
pinev: Placed at the section centre; the grade junction can be up to about 800 m away
Unconfirmed, one source

new.n: Washburn Resort, Portage Ship Canal Upper Entrance (1911 plat)
new.pl: E side of sec. 28 T56N R34W, east of the Ship Canal, Houghton County
new.v: Coins, jewelry, resort-era bottles and tokens
new.st: The 1911 Houghton County plat book (T56N R34W page) prints "Washburn Resort" east of the Ship Canal at the Upper Entrance, beside the Life Saving Station and the Light House. This is close to F.J. McLain State Park, so part of the ground may be park land.
new.t: Check first whether the spot is inside McLain State Park: Michigan state parks need a permit to detect. Outside the park, ask the landowner first.

new.n: Grave by the Rod River, T54N R36W (1911 plat)
new.pl: NE corner of sec. 10 / NW sec. 11 T54N R36W, by the old river road, Houghton County
new.st: The 1911 Houghton County plat book (T54N R36W page) prints "Grave" beside the Rod River at the NE corner of sec. 10 and NW sec. 11, next to the old road that follows the river. Look only: this is a burial.
new.t: Look only. Never detect or dig at or near a grave: disturbing a burial is a crime in Michigan.
